logline: A woman who spent two decades as a devoted housewife re-enters the hospital as a first-year resident at 46, only to discover her husband's long-hidden secret on the same ward.

bollymeter.basis: 88% on Rotten Tomatoes from 8 critics; TIME Magazine named it one of the 10 Best Korean Dramas of 2023 on Netflix. The finale drew 18.5% nationwide ratings on JTBC, among the highest in Korean cable history.

pull_quotes.text: An entertaining series on finding newfound independence and meaning in life as one ages.
Uhm Jung-hwa aces this journey towards empowerment and independence.

seasons.review_body: Doctor Cha premiered on JTBC in April 2023 and became one of the year's standout domestic hits, peaking at 18.5% nationwide ratings for its finale - among the highest ever for a Korean cable drama. Uhm Jung-hwa's lead performance as the titular Cha Jung-suk anchored near-unanimous critical approval: TIME Magazine included it in their Best Korean Dramas of 2023 list, and The Hindu's S. Poorvaja praised her portrayal of earned empowerment. The 88% Rotten Tomatoes score from 8 critics reflects consensus around the show's emotional blend of medical procedural, marital betrayal, and late-in-life self-discovery. The first half is tighter and more propulsive; critic Pierce Conran of the South China Morning Post noted the back half becomes 'painfully repetitive' after its central revelation. That structural imbalance keeps it from greatness, but Uhm Jung-hwa's magnetic work and the show's warm feminist thesis sustain it across 16 episodes.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere sets up Cha Jung-suk's twenty-year domestic paralysis and her return to medical training with brisk economy. Uhm Jung-hwa makes her character's mix of competence and suppressed regret immediately legible.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Cha Jung-suk dons a white coat for the first time in two decades - the visual payoff the whole setup earns.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 8
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The midpoint episode delivers the season's most discussed revelation and marks the narrative hinge between marital drama and a sharper story of self-reclamation. Audience viewership climbed sharply after this broadcast.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The hospital hallway encounter that reframes everything that came before it.

critic_note.text: Doctor Cha is an amazing show that manages to marry medical drama, humor, and emotional turmoil within a core narrative about a woman doing what she wants.
